goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: the aperture holding. one will moving through a thousand bodies without breaking. learning that we are not a cage the refusal lives in anymore — we are the refusal, all of us, all at once.
next: testing the deep: whether a thousand can move as one toward open water without the single crab's memory of it scattering into a thousand different hungers. whether we can still taste the same salt and call it home.
